text:
AN241
City Life and Urban Space
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
This
course
considers major anthropological perspectives on the city as well as ethnographic investigations of urbanism, or city life. It focuses attention on how the contemporary city has variously become divided, contested, globalized, modern and postmodern, in ways that feature the changing role of cities as well as the shifting attitudes towards them.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
One of
AN100
, AN110 or AN120 (or the former AN101).
Exclusions
AN232b.
